Our Process

Every bite tells a story of tradition, patience, and absolute perfection.

  • 1. Ingredient Selection: Only the finest nuts, pure ghee, and saffron.
  • 2. Traditional Preparation: Slow-cooked to bring out authentic flavors.
  • 3. Quality Inspection: Hand-checked for consistency and taste.
  • 4. Careful Packaging: Packed to preserve ultimate freshness.
